patronage_payable.meaning: cash patronage declared and not yet paid on this holding; identically cash declared and voided payments minus cash paid (always 0.00 on classes that receive no patronage)

issued_date.meaning: date the holding was first issued

retired_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty until retired or cancelled
retired_date.meaning: date the holding was retired in full or the subscription was cancelled

retirement_requested_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty unless a retirement or redemption request is pending
retirement_requested_date.meaning: date the member's (or estate's) written retirement or redemption request took effect on the holding

patronage_payment_method.meaning: how the member has chosen to receive cash patronage and retirement proceeds on this holding (applied_to_loan is for cash patronage only)

deposit_account_last4.meaning: last four digits of the checking account for direct deposit

apply_to_loan_id.meaning: loan chosen to receive cash patronage when the method is applied_to_loan (an operating line, equipment, farm real estate or Country Home loan of the member); empty otherwise

apply_to_loan_line.meaning: product line of apply_to_loan_id; none when the method is not applied_to_loan

dividend_option.meaning: for preferred stock, whether dividends are paid in cash or reinvested in additional shares; none for every other class

eq_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the equity transaction

equity_id.meaning: equity holding the transaction posts to (foreign key -> equity_accounts)

event_type.meaning: transaction family, taken verbatim from the equity charter's event types

amount.meaning: magnitude of the transaction; its effect on balance or patronage payable is fixed by the event type

patronage_year.meaning: calendar year of loan volume the patronage was earned on (for allocations, cash, voids and revolvements of allocated surplus)

source_loan_id.meaning: the loan the row concerns: the loan whose eligible balance earned a patronage allocation, the loan whose closing required a stock purchase, the loan cash patronage or an offset was applied to; empty otherwise

source_loan_line.meaning: product line of source_loan_id; none when there is no source loan

eligible_adb.format: USD, 2 decimal places; empty when not an allocation
eligible_adb.meaning: patronage-eligible average daily balance of the source loan for the patronage year, as computed by the year-end patronage run

patronage_rate_pct.format: percent, 3 decimal places; empty when not an allocation
patronage_rate_pct.meaning: patronage rate declared by the board for the source loan's line and year

payment_method.meaning: how money moved: payout by check or direct deposit, cash patronage applied to a loan, a purchase paid in cash or deducted from loan proceeds at closing, or a dividend reinvested; none for allocations and offsets

check_number.meaning: association check number for a payout by check, as printed; empty otherwise

retirement_reason.meaning: why equity was retired; none on non-retirement rows

source_ref_id.meaning: the single record this row derives from: the payout a void reverses, the void a reissue replaces; empty otherwise

request_id.meaning: primary id of the equity service request

customer_id.meaning: requesting member or estate representative's member record (foreign key -> customers)

equity_id.meaning: equity holding the request concerns (foreign key -> equity_accounts)

requested_amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when the whole holding or no amount applies
requested_amount.meaning: amount of preferred stock to redeem; 0.00 otherwise

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
